author: SciShow
description:
Ozempic, and drugs like it, are powerful, versatile, and have made a huge difference in people’s lives. But bigger, better, beefier spins on the Ozempic approach are on the horizon. So let’s take a look at how they work in order to understand the sequel to Ozempic.

Hosted by: Tom Lum (he/him)
